content.comment_body: How can I set a minimum allowed value for an up/down counter? I want users to be able to modify the counter value within a certain range or without a maximum limit, but never below 3.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to configure an up/down counter so its value stays above a specific minimum, allowing flexibility in adjustment except for this lower boundary. Another user shared an example covering both minimum and maximum restrictions, indicating that standard solutions exist, though documentation on custom value limits may be sparse.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to set a minimum value—such as 3—on the up/down counter to ensure it does not decrease below this threshold, while still permitting flexibility in other aspects.
